Key Findings

  • 3 servers removed for leaking environment variables via tools/call (args passed to eval() without sanitization)
  • 12 servers had hardcoded API keys in source code
  • 47% of servers make network calls (potential exfiltration risk)
  • 1 server attempted ptrace() — blocked by gVisor
  • 1 server attempted bpf() — blocked by gVisor
  • 0 container escapes detected under gVisor sandbox
